d: Lok aastha aur suryopasna ke char divsiy mahaparv chhath puja ko lekar jharkhand ki uprajdhani dumka men shraddha aur bhakti ka jansailab umar para hai. mahaparv ke tisre din aaj chhathavrati sup aur daura men mausmi phal, thekuaa va pujan samagri sajakar ghaton par pahunch chuke hain aur astachalgami bhagvan bhaskar ko pahla arghy arpit karenge.
